text:
Margo, the savvy detective, has been on the tail of the elusive art thief known as 'The Phantom' for years. In the original story, Margo finally catches The Phantom in a climactic encounter at the Louvre, revealing him to be her long-lost brother. Alternative Ending:

Margo corners The Phantom in the dimly lit corridors of the Louvre, her gun trained on the shadowy figure. Instead of a dramatic reveal of familial ties, the figure steps into the light, and Margo is stunned to see not her brother, but a sophisticated parrot perched on a mannequin, mimicking the voice of her brother perfectly. The "Phantom" was never a person, but a master thief who used trained birds to distract guards and mimic voices to create alibis. The real thief, her brother, had been using the bird as a decoy all along, escaping through a hidden passage while Margo was distracted by the illusion.
